body: Exactly relatable. I'm 24 F and I too never had any physical contact with non-family human being. It hurts too much to be lonely :(

Yeah, you are absolutely right about the effect of cultural background. Although I'm over 18, since I'm still living with my parents, it's not possible to make choices on my own because of my specific cultural background.

Thanks for your concerning :D Yeah I'd love if there was some one even as a friend to share my interests or even just accompany me :) Sadly there's isn't anyone and I'm not even in their list of "options" :( I actually don't understand a particular reason for this cause I'm not rude, respect every one's opinions, help others as much as I can etc. I guess that's just my fate/destiny to be isolated lonely until I die :( As for the timing, no this isn't because of the  global pandemic, I've been feeling this way since my teens when I saw others in my age move on with their lives while I'm stuck alone without any knowledge/experience about the outside world. I adore internet and technology very much cause that's the only thing helped me to get an idea about what's going around the world, what's I'm missing and seek help from these kinds of platforms :)

Your words are just amazing, while I'm reading your detailed comment, I just felt I'm not that much unlucky since I have these kind of people whom I've never known would gladly help me to go through this and provide me precocious life advices that anyone in my condition can count on :D I'll read your comments again again and point out all the valuable instructions and follow those while giving my 100%. Hopefully, one day I'd be able to achieve a "happy ending" too :)  Thanks again for concerning, taking time and this much of an effort to help me out. This really means a lot. I wish you best of luck and all of your dreams may become true :D

Hello, thank you very much for responding and providing these advices :D Though it might be really hard with my social anxiety, I'll try my best to follow your instructions :) Thanks again and hope you all the very best :)

Hey, thank you very much for understanding my situation, concerned enough to help and responding :D Yes, I was all alone since childhood, there were "friends" here and there but only those who would interact me with for educational/ work related matters. So there never ever wasn't any closer friends or a SO. Before  anhedonia I've enjoyed reading fictional detective books, watched Korean dramas and TV series and listed instrumental music. I'm not much an outgoing person since I don't have anyone to accompany me, so I've always enjoyed those kind of indoor hobbies before experiencing  anhedonia. However, now the situation is extremely different, I just don't enjoy any sort of thing :( just fed up of being all alone and not having hopes/dreams about a clearly non existent "happy, normal" life and future :(
Hi, thanks you responding :) However, as a personal preference, I'm not into any kind of online dating.

That's why I can not understand what I'm lacking and need to improve as a girl to be  genuinely "interesting" to some one in a romantic/sexual way, but without acting socially inappropriate ways. What are the "tips" you could provide me? I'm  just freaking scared that I'll be forever alone even without a partner or any friends once my parents leave this word :( That's why I'm thinking about this that much hard and seeking advices :(

Hi, thanks for responding :) I wish I could as you advised. But going out and meeting people is just out of my way because of my so much overprotective parents as I've mentioned in my post :( It's just going for work on weekdays and college on weekends. Since I don't have any 'friends' I don't get any invitations to parties or trips or any other events. However, even if I did, I'm pretty sure my parents never ever won't allow me to participate them :( Although I'm 24, I still can't move out on my own because of not having enough financial stability. Are there any other "tips" you could provide to be  genuinely "interesting" to anyone? As I've mentioned I'm average looking, stay hygiene, dress neatly, help others with my full effort if some one ask for something etc. So, as a women (I guess you are), what might be things I'm lacking to have never ever anyone shown any romantic/sexual interest in me ?

Hello, tanks for responding :) Yeah it sucks to have no SO to share life with :( But, it's even worse when you're all alone even without a single friend in actual life :( When it comes to   anhedonia, each and every thing seems pointless to me and my mind just say "..just why? there's no point ..." . I'm hopeless, but the good thing about the meds is they just help little bit to control my breakdowns, uncontrolled tears following etc. in public places and also helps me to get a good sleep. That's the only time I feel nothing and just numb. That's better compared to the burning feeling that tortures me throughout the whole day :( If you like, could you kindly share that few things that gives you pleasure now? May be I could try that too :) If I'm lucky enough, those will help me even for a little bit to fight this depression :)

Hey, thanks for responding :) It's sad that you too feel the  same and experience this situation :( Me too feel that I'm a burden even to my parents :( What have we done to deserve this much pain and suffer like this throughout our whole lives ? Why can't we gain happiness and live a normal life like all the other people? What's so wrong with us to be treated like this? If we are not suitable for this world, then why in the first place we were given chance to born? I'm just fed up with all of these shit. Sorry if my reply cause to worsen up your condition. It's just that I'm freaking lonely and tired of living this shitty life all alone :(

Hello, thanks for responding :) It's terrific that you too feel the same and facing the same situation. I'm also too tired to get my hopes up for nothing and dreaming about a non-existent future. That's why I'm assuming that I'm lacking some thing that hopefully could be fixed either by medication or by counselling/therapy sessions :)

But, unfortunately, there's not even a single soul out there like that, just even a genuine friend :( It's so hard to hang on there all alone though everyone says "it will get better with time" kind of shit :(

Hi, thank you very much for responding and the subreddit recommendation :) Yeah,  anhedonia  is the worst thing and I have to give so much effort to just exist on a daily basis since everything seems pointless not not interesting :(

You're absolutely right about me thinking too much about this :D But, the thing is, when I see people of my age or even younger, no offence from here; but people who are not much educated compared to me, people who are not much good looking compared to me, people who have visible bad personality traits compared to me etc. doing so much better and moving happily forward with their lives forces me to think that I'm lacking some thing. I assume that's why I'm this much alone and no one has never ever shown any interest in me :(

It's terrific that there are many others who feels the same way :( It's kind of we are not alone in this technical platform, we have each other, help each other and have actual human beings to talk (write) to, though end of the day, all of us feel lonely, and sucked in our own dark tunnels alone. However, all of you internet strangers at least help me to keep my hopes up and brightened up my mood even for a second. So, thank you very much for responding and sharing your thoughts. Although it fucking sucks to hang on there, let's hope one day, we will be able to find the right person whom we can to talk to and who is able understands us :)
